Description: Value of the KPI on the current row of Cfg_Threshold[KPI_Name] for the selected site and report day (Report Date). % KPIs are fractions (0.82 = 82%); times in minutes.
End-of-day forecast of the KPI (production run rate, TTAT trend, utilisation flow). Blank when the KPI has no forecast.
OK / WARNING / CRITICAL against the site's limits ([Thr Eff Warn], [Thr Eff Crit]); NO DATA = no activity in the window; N/A = the site has no such process; INFO = a setting, not a KPI.
Status of the end-of-day forecast [KPI Predicted] against the same limits as [KPI Status].
Target in use for the KPI at the selected site (inputs file overrides the built-in default in config/kpi_thresholds.csv).
Warning limit in use for the KPI at the selected site.
Critical limit in use for the KPI at the selected site.
Status of the alert rule on the current row of Cfg_AlertRule for the selected site: OK / WARNING / CRITICAL / NO DATA / N/A.
What a breach of this alert rule means (shown only when the rule is in WARNING or CRITICAL).
Recommended action for the alert rule when it is in WARNING or CRITICAL; the owner is Cfg_AlertRule[Owner].
Per Cfg_AlertRule row that is open: status, actual vs target and the recommended action (blank when the rule is OK).
Number of alert rules in CRITICAL for the selected site and report day.
Number of alert rules in WARNING for the selected site and report day.
One-line state of the site: number of critical and warning alerts and whether to act now.
Main constraint of the site right now: space allocation, racking capacity, warehouse full, production line or none - with the numbers behind it.
Recommended order to fix the open alerts (critical first), with the action for each.
Production outlook of the report day: pallets so far, run rate, projected end-of-day output vs the ramp-up plan.
What to check when the KPI is off target (config/kpi_explain.csv Diagnosis).
How the KPI is calculated, in plain words.
The numbers behind the KPI value for the selected site and day.
How the end-of-day forecast of the KPI is made.
Probable root cause for the production line on the current row of 'Produced Pallet'[PRODUCT_LINE] (line down, low, surge, storage block, Level A congestion); blank when the line is NORMAL.
Recommended action for the production line on the current row of 'Produced Pallet'[PRODUCT_LINE]; blank when the line is NORMAL.
Shift day shown by the report: the date picked on the Day slicer, otherwise the newest site-local shift day with activity.
Data as of: time of the last data refresh in the selected site's local time.
Banner text: data as of, when a new copy is published, and a warning when the copy is old.
Name of the selected site with its plant code.
Hour-by-hour verdict of the report day: hours with no movement, below baseline or slow trucks.
